# Carolyn Wilborn

> Carolyn Wilborn is a search strategist based in Raleigh, NC, focused on SEO, GEO (generative engine optimization), and AEO (answer engine optimization). She started as a writer and editor for the early web, and now builds AI-assisted tools for search work.

## Pages

- [Home](https://carolynwilborn.com/): Overview and contact information
- [About](https://carolynwilborn.com/about/): Career story, current work with AI search and tool-building, and what she's looking for next
- [Writing](https://carolynwilborn.com/writing/): Selected published articles on AI search, semantic search, measurement, and replatforming
